documents.name: Planning Commission Minutes February 5 2024
documents.synopsis: Official minutes of the February 5, 2024 Sykesville Planning Commission meeting. The Commission closed the Enclave at Parkside public hearing, reviewed developer responses to staff comments, declined to grant conditional approval, and approved the 2023 Annual Report.
documents.description: January 2 minutes approved unanimously. Business: (1) Enclave at Parkside — public hearing closed unanimously; developer addressed staff comments (5 ft end unit setback retained, building separations kept as proposed, Note 33 to follow code); developer requested conditional approval but Commission was not ready to act. (2) 2023 Annual Report approved unanimously. Town updates: Joy Property B-L zone text amendment approved by Mayor and Town Council; College Avenue stop work order; Zoning Rewrite progressing. Adjourned 7:40 PM.

documents.name: Staff Report
documents.synopsis: Carroll County Bureau of Comprehensive Planning staff report for the April 1, 2024 PC meeting covering Water and Sewer, Housing Study, and 2023 Annual Report updates.
documents.description: County updates: (1) Water and Sewer: Spring Amendment cycle finalizing — 6 amendments in process, County PC certifying/forwarding to BCC at 4/16 meeting; BCC expected to adopt in May and forward to MDE. (2) Housing Study: final setup for website, survey, and community needs assessment meetings in April-May; Mosaic Community Planning facilitating; study completion targeted for fall. (3) 2023 Annual Report: compiling county and municipal information, due to MDP by July 1.

documents.name: Staff Report
documents.original_filename: Staff Report - 7503 Village Rd Site Plan
documents.synopsis: Staff report for the April 1, 2024 Planning Commission site plan review for 7503 Village Rd (Parcel 4406-2, B-L), converting a convenience store to a barber shop. Staff recommends approval with a parking size modification for 8 sub-standard spaces.
documents.description: The applicant proposes to convert a 2,000 sq ft convenience store to a barber shop at 7503 Village Rd. The B-L zone allows barber shops as a principal permitted use; §180-95 requires Planning Commission site plan approval. The site has operated with the same layout since the early 1980s. The site plan shows 13 spaces (4 standard 9x20, 1 handicap, 8 sub-standard 9x17.5 along the perimeter). No minimum parking is required for the proposed use. Staff recommends approval plus authorization of a parking size modification for the 8 sub-standard spaces, noting the Town Code permits the Planning Commission to waive parking standards in the B-L zone where adequate parking exists.

documents.name: Site Plan
documents.synopsis: Exterior site plan for the proposed barber shop at 7503 Village Rd, showing the existing parking layout, building footprint, and proposed parking restriping.
documents.description: Site plan drawing for 7503 Village Rd showing the 2,000 sq ft building, 13 parking spaces (4 standard 9x20, 1 handicap, 8 sub-standard 9x17.5 along the perimeter), and proposed restriping of the front spaces to provide a handicap accessible space. No changes to the exterior site layout are proposed beyond the parking restriping.
